confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Skopje's price levels, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary more by season and property. Drink anchors are bounded by typical local beer and wine pricing. FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA page and was not independently opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Balkan capitals with similar price levels and tourism profiles, such as Sofia, Tirana, Podgorica and Belgrade, adjusted to Skopje's local price levels.
